record.title: Maseru Bridge blocked by cross-border taxi dispute in January 2017
record.scope: Maseru Bridge border post; other Free State ports affected but not specified
record.direction: Lesotho-to-South Africa operators specifically obstructed; wider passenger movement disrupted
record.exceptions: Approximately 400 pedestrians reportedly crossed on January 3 while motorists were obstructed; no universal closure or complete exception inventory established.
record.imposing_authority: Competing South African and Lesotho taxi operators; non-state blockade
record.enforcement: Physical obstruction of border post confirmed by transport ministry
record.consequences: Cross-border commuters inconvenienced and legitimate operators prevented from working.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; current status not inferred
record.official_rationale: No state closure rationale: minister describes unlawful obstruction arising from competing taxi operators
record.context: Free State operators prevented legitimate Lesotho operators conducting cross-border services. A deliberate non-state blockade disrupted movement.
record.uncertainty: Closure on three named dates, not proven uninterrupted throughout. Reopening occurred before ministerial statement on 13 January; exact date not assigned.
